scenes.text: Integers include positive and negative numbers. On the number line right adds and left subtracts.
Calculate 10 plus (3). The answer is 13. On the number line, start at 10 and move plus 3.
The thermometer at a farm reads -14 degrees C and changes by plus 12 degrees C. What does it read afterward? Pause the video and think.
The thermometer at a farm reads -14 degrees C and changes by plus 12 degrees C. What does it read afterward? The answer is -2. On the number line, start at -14 and move plus 12.
